Challenge H1 asked whether Google Workspace contributed significantly or equally to the growth. The retrieved evidence (E7, E9, E13) only describes the general composition of Google Cloud revenues but provides no specific information about Google Workspace's contribution to Q3 2026 growth. Challenge H2 asked whether TPU system sales (rather than ongoing Platform services) were the primary driver. This is refuted by E1, which explicitly states the growth was "largely from infrastructure and platform services" with TPU system sales mentioned as an additional factor, not the primary one.

Challenge H3 asked whether any breakdown showed Workspace or other components contributed more than Platform. No such breakdown was found in the evidence.

The initial verdict remains SUPPORTED as none of the challenges found evidence contradicting the claim.
